title: StructuredClone / GetterCarrier Addrof Leak
detail: ds-addrof.js corrupts the getterCarrier function array slot via MessageChannel structured clone deserialization, yielding high-reliability 64-bit object address leaks across WebKit versions without reliance on DFG JIT.

title: Arbitrary Read/Write Fake Object Alignment
detail: ds-composition.js aligns fake array butterfly pointers at delta 0x10 from host address, constructing a synthetic TypedArray backing store that provides stable, non-destructive arbitrary 64-bit memory read/write.

title: Pure Bytecode Libkernel Stub Scanner
detail: kernel-stubs.js scans a 0x20000 window around getpid export (0xb8 opcode) to extract syscall IDs (getpid, close, pipe, unlink, thr_self) with 100% deterministic matching across 23 firmwares.

title: FW 13.60 Verified Offset Table
detail: offsets/offsets.json contains exact verified offsets for FW 13.60 (hc=[0x1e0d8, 0x1e320, 0x1f368], gd=0x1d11a, nt=0x4740, gps=0x34f57b8, gpe=0x1b860, cls=0x34f57a8, cle=0x274e0).

title: 12 On-Device Research Payloads Fully Wired
detail: The payload suite in payloads/*.js covers process diagnostics, memory canary inspection, API error code checks, sysmodule loading, IPMI daemon IPC fuzzing, AVPlayer demux probing, and libSceXml parser dispatching.

title: libSceAvPlayer MP4 Box Size Gate Tests
detail: video-test.html and media/evil_st*.mp4 provide test cases targeting 32-bit count truncation in stts/stco/stss/stsz atom demuxing.

title: Standalone Offline Host Server Suite
detail: host/ provides DNS spoofing (fakedns.py), HTTP/HTTPS serving (host.py), appcache manifest generation for offline execution, and binary memory dump collection (dumpserver.py).

title: Non-blocking Live Telemetry Pipeline
detail: telemetry.js and telemetry_logger.py implement a dedicated TCP trace streaming pipeline to avoid DOM garbage collection pressure on WebKit during intense memory exploration.

title: libSceXml Entity Text Decoding Buffer-Growth Predicate Flaw
detail: In libSceXml.sprx (0x1179c / 0x11849 in decoder 0x115b0), the buffer-growth check tests `OUT CAP + vlen > OUT LEN` instead of `OUT LEN + vlen <= OUT CAP`. Because `OUT CAP > OUT LEN` is always true, growth is skipped, resulting in a heap buffer overflow when appending entity strings larger than the remaining capacity.

title: libSceAvPlayer 32-bit Integer Wraparound in Atom Allocation
detail: In libSceAvPlayer / demuxer parsers, 32-bit atom count descriptors (stco, stsc, stss, stsz) calculate heap allocation sizes using 32-bit arithmetic `count * sizeof(entry)`. A count of 0x40000000 causes an integer overflow wrapping the allocation to 0/small byte buffer, triggering out-of-bounds heap writes during subsequent entry ingestion.

title: libSceSysmodule In-Process Dynamic Loading Boundary
detail: sceSysmoduleLoadModuleByNameInternal allows unprivileged WebProcess to map approved system SPRXs into userland memory space. This expands the process symbol table and exposes client-side IPC stubs to background daemons.

title: libSceNetCtl / libSceIpmi Client-to-Daemon Serialization
detail: Client libraries serialize userland requests into shared memory/sockets for SceNetCtlDaemon and system services. The attack surface shifts from WebProcess to daemon message deserializers handling structured command buffers.

title: libSceHttp2 HPACK Table State & WebSocket Frame Handling
detail: libSceHttp2 maintains an in-process state machine for multiplexed streams, dynamic HPACK decompression tables, and native WebSockets. Frame length field mismatches and invalid dynamic table index lookups represent state desynchronization surfaces.

title: 12.00→12.70 Series Contains Zero Semantic Code Changes in Web-Surface Libraries
detail: RIP-relativized instruction-level diff across 12.00/12.20/12.70 for 10 web libraries (libSceAvPlayer stts handler, libSceXml decoder, libSceJson2 parser, libSceHttp2 all 72 exports, libSceNetCtl all 124 exports, libSceSysmodule loader, libSceVnaWebsocket, libSceWebmParserMdrw, libSceZlib, libSceJson) shows byte-identical security-relevant functions. The 12.60 dump is a different build line (0/308 libs contain W:/Build paths vs 268/269 in 12.70) and must be excluded from patch-series comparison. FINDING-009 (libSceXml) and FINDING-010 (libSceAvPlayer) remain unpatched in 12.70.

title: libSceHttp2 Embeds Patched zlib 1.2.13 with In-Process Gzip Inflate
detail: libSceHttp2.sprx has no libSceZlib import and no CRC32 table, but contains the string '1.2.13' adjacent to classic zlib error strings ('invalid block type', 'invalid distance code'). Gzip decompression of server-controlled response bodies runs in-process. Version 1.2.13 is patched against CVE-2022-37434, so no known zlib CVE applies; the embedded inflate remains a MEDIUM-priority fuzz target.

title: libSceWebTransport (priv) Embeds ngtcp2 QUIC/HTTP3 with In-Process Packet Parsing
detail: libSceWebTransport.sprx (219 exports, 279 imports) imports LibreSSL3 (BIO/EVP/SSL/X509/PEM), libScePosix raw sockets, libSceNet and contains ngtcp2 assertion strings ('ngtcp2_pkt.c(920)', 'ngtcp2_conn.c(1067)') plus QUIC v1/v2 markers. In-process QUIC packet parsing (ngtcp2_pkt_decode) is a fresh large attack surface reachable from network input; symbol recovery of NID-encoded exports is the prerequisite for deeper analysis.

title: libSceIpmi is the Actual IPC Trust Boundary (ipmimgr_call + authinfo gating)
detail: libSceIpmi.sprx (98 exports) implements ClientImpl/ServerImpl/SessionImpl with kernel-mediated ipmimgr_call syscall, get_authinfo/get_self_auth_info privilege queries, and SessionImpl::isPeerPrivileged @0x3ba0 which maps kernel authinfo results to 0x80020002/0x80020003. Session privilege is kernel-determined, not caller-controlled. libSceNetCtl (124 exports) and libSceWtIpcClient (13 exports) are thin IPMI clients; the privileged-side deserializers (ServerImpl::tryDispatch @0x1910, runDispatcher @0x1d90) live in daemon processes not present in this dump.

title: libSceWebmParserMdrw EBML ID Reader and libSceVnaWebsocket Frame Lengths are Properly Bounded
detail: libSceWebmParserMdrw EBML ID reader @0x6480 caps ID length at 4 bytes (cmp ecx,4; jbe @0x64bc) with 8-bit shift-accumulate @0x6539; the library is a thumbnail generator handing off to libSceMediaFrameworkInterface (sceMediaFwGetThumbnail), not a full demuxer. libSceVnaWebsocket frame length selector @0x32a rejects lengths > 0x7fffffff and handles 0x7e/0x7f extended lengths with 16/64-bit reads. Both libraries verified free of obvious length truncation; libSceSysmodule path templates use snprintf into fixed 0x100 stack buffers (no overflow).
